cases.case: SOURCE CANDIDATE: plain self-targeted putCounter, counterType '+1/+1'
cases.mirrors: Exemplar of Light (FDN #11) — real "put a +1/+1 counter on this creature" effect
cases.note: Mocked Creature with effects:[{kind:'putCounter', target:'self', counterType:'+1/+1', amount:1}]. Verified in counters.test.ts via the entry's own CallableSink contract (entry(card)), which now inspects deriveOccurrences directly — no SinkQuery involved.

cases.mirrors: a real "when this enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it" permanent
cases.note: Mocked creature whose onEnter trigger's own effects contain kind:'putCounter', counterType:'+1/+1' — proves trigger effects are walked, not just top-level effects. Verified via entry(card).

cases.mirrors: a real "put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control" effect
cases.note: Mocked Sorcery with effects:[{kind:'putCounterAll', predicate:'creatures-you-control', counterType:'+1/+1', amount:1}]. Verified via entry(card).

cases.mirrors: any real card that puts a -1/-1 counter instead — a genuinely different mechanic
cases.note: Mocked Sorcery with effects:[{kind:'putCounterTarget', validType:'creature', counterType:'-1/-1', amount:1}]. Proves real discrimination on counter type, not 'any putCounter counts'. Verified via entry(card).

cases.case: SOURCE CANDIDATE: vanilla creature, no effects at all
cases.mirrors: Serra Angel (FDN) — a real, deliberate no-sink case
cases.note: Mocked vanilla creature. Verified via entry(card).

cases.case: SINK CANDIDATE: named trigger 'onCounterAdded', checked standalone from the source-candidate check
cases.mirrors: the real Exemplar of Light (FDN #11) shape — "whenever one or more counters are put on this creature, draw a card"
cases.note: Mocked creature whose only trigger is named 'onCounterAdded'. Verified in counters.test.ts via matchesConsumerTriggerNames.

cases.mirrors: any real card whose trigger reacts to something else entirely
cases.note: Mocked creature with a trigger named 'onAttack'. Verified via matchesConsumerTriggerNames.

cases.case: SINK CANDIDATE: no triggers at all
cases.mirrors: Serra Angel (FDN) again, for the sink-candidate recognition mode specifically
cases.note: Mocked vanilla creature. Verified via matchesConsumerTriggerNames.

cases.case: SINK CANDIDATE: named trigger on the BACK face of a transforming DFC
cases.mirrors: a transforming DFC whose back face carries the reactive trigger
cases.note: Mocked front/back face pair; the 'onCounterAdded' trigger lives only on backFace.triggers. Verified via matchesConsumerTriggerNames.

cases.case: CALLABLE: source-candidate-only match returns real detail
cases.mirrors: the real plain self-targeted putCounter SOURCE CANDIDATE case above, exercised via the CallableSink contract
cases.note: Proves entry(candidate) faithfully reflects the direct deriveOccurrences-based producer check. Verified in counters.test.ts.

cases.case: CALLABLE: sink-candidate-only match returns real detail
cases.mirrors: the real 'onCounterAdded' SINK CANDIDATE case above, exercised via the CallableSink contract instead of matchesConsumerTriggerNames directly
cases.note: Proves entry(candidate) faithfully carries through matchesConsumerTriggerNames's own verdict. Verified in counters.test.ts.

cases.case: CALLABLE: no source-candidate or sink-candidate signal returns null
cases.mirrors: the real vanilla-creature no-match case above, exercised via the CallableSink contract
cases.note: Proves entry(candidate) returns null, not a falsy match object, when neither signal fires. Verified in counters.test.ts.
